text: The rooftop view and ambiance were magical! Food tasted delicious, especially the seafood pasta. However, check-in wait time was over 45 minutes and the room bathroom was not properly cleaned.
Spotless room, plush mattress, and attentive staff that greeted us warmly. Breakfast buffet was fresh and plentiful. Excellent value for money!
Bland and cold steak served an hour late. The waiter was indifferent and argued about our bill when we noticed incorrect charges. Avoid this restaurant at all costs!
Cozy atmosphere and romantic lighting. The cocktails were superb, but the music was slightly too loud for a quiet conversation.
